prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1088; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while it was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of the collision and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. Kindly provide written confirmation of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with the declarations page and any applicable excess or umbrella coverage information.

We further request that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including vehicle data, photographs, dash camera footage, telematics information, witness statements, repair estimates, and claim file materials. Please treat this letter as formal notice of the need to preserve all such evidence pending resolution of our client's claim.
